meta.name: dial-cli
meta.description: Reference for the `dial` CLI — gives you a real phone number to send SMS, place AI voice calls, and receive inbound texts/codes via the Dial platform (getdial.ai). Use when the user mentions phones, calls, texts, SMS, voice, OTP, 2FA, or verification codes; when they ask to text, call, ring, or wait for a code from someone; before running any `dial …` command for the first time in a session; or when investigating what the Dial platform can do. Load this skill before invoking the CLI — `dial --help` alone will not surface the workflows, the `--json` conventions, or the docs-lookup pattern needed to use Dial correctly.

copy.tagline: 用命令行发送短信、拨打电话并接收验证码
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要在命令行中完成短信和通话
copy.tagline_en: Send SMS, make voice calls, and receive codes from the command line
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a real phone number for texts and calls via CLI

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能通过 dial 命令发送短信、拨打 AI 语音电话、购买或管理电话号码,并等待接收短信验证码等入站事件。它使用预设好的号码和凭据,无需你配置。
howto.when: 当你提到电话、短信、验证码等词,或要求发短信、打电话、等验证码时,Claude 会使用该技能;在首次运行 dial 命令前也会加载。

say.note: Claude 会调用 dial 发送短信。

say.text: 打给 +14155550123,让 AI 说‘你好,我是助理’。
say.note: Claude 会发起 AI 语音通话。

say.text: 等一条短信验证码,收到就告诉我。
say.note: Claude 会监听短信事件并读出验证码。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude can use the `dial` CLI to send SMS, place AI voice calls, manage numbers, and wait for codes. Credentials are pre-set, so no setup is needed.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention phones, texts, or verification codes, or ask to send an SMS, place a call, or wait for a code. Also loaded before the first `dial` command in a session.

say_en.text: Send a text to +14155550123 with the message 'Hello'.
say_en.note: Claude uses the dial CLI to send it.

say_en.text: Call +14155550123 and have the AI say 'Hi, this is your assistant'.
say_en.note: Claude places an AI voice call.

say_en.text: Wait for an SMS verification code and tell me what it is.
say_en.note: Claude listens for the inbound SMS and reports the code.
